description: The file is a PHP script that handles AJAX requests for adding or modifying device entries in a network configuration system. It includes functions for validating IP addresses and MAC addresses, manages static and DHCP reservations, and updates device info in configuration tables.

methods.name: isIPValid
methods.description: Validates whether an input IP address and MAC address are within acceptable ranges and not reserved for special purposes or conflicts in DHCP/static IP reservations.
